_doc: Real-crypto failing fixture (N-198). Same pubKey and sighash as the pass fixture, but an EMPTY signature (EMPTY_SIG). OP_CHECKSIG pushes false for an empty signature even under NULLFAIL, so real-crypto mode raises AssertionFailureError at the assert(checkSig(...)) binding — the counterpart of real-crypto-p2pkh-fail.json, whose non-empty failing signature aborts instead.
